# Terms of Service

By purchasing a ticket to Duvelnacht, you agree to abide by our terms and conditions. All attendees must be 18 or older with valid photo ID. Tickets are non-refundable and non-transferable except in cases of official event cancellation.

## Prohibited Items
- Professional recording equipment
- Outside food and beverages
- Glass containers
- Illegal substances

## Liability
Attendees participate at their own risk. Event organizers are not responsible for lost, stolen, or damaged personal property.
legal.privacy:
# Privacy Policy

We collect minimal personal information necessary for ticket sales and event communication. Your email address will only be used for event updates and our monthly newsletter (opt-in only).

## Data Collection
- Name and email for ticket purchases
- Payment information (processed securely through our payment partner)
- Optional newsletter subscription

## Data Protection
We do not sell, share, or distribute your personal information to third parties except as required for payment processing and event logistics.
